nodes.rationale: Central configuration via config class constants.

nodes.rationale: Per-scraper rotating proxy system to prevent blocks.

nodes.label: Cookie Management

nodes.label: Docker Compose
nodes.rationale: Multi-service orchestration with fourget and frontend.
